column1: # #2738: local-alias -> upstream mapping for roster models Ollama's client-side
# hf.co name validation refuses to pull directly.
# Bisected live against Ollama 0.32.13: `ollama pull hf.co/<owner>/<repo>:<tag>`
# rejects the request with a bare `400 Bad Request: invalid model name` in
# under a second -- before any network transfer -- whenever the REPO NAME
# SEGMENT (the part between the owner slash and the colon) exceeds 80
# characters. It is the segment, not the total string: an 81-char segment
# under the short `hf.co/ab/` prefix still fails; a 100-char total with an
# 80-char segment passes. `ollama create ... -f Modelfile` with a `FROM
# hf.co/...` source hits the identical validation (confirmed live) -- the
# check is on parsing/resolving the hf.co-shaped reference itself, not on
# which end (pull destination vs. create source) it appears on. The only
# path around it is a `FROM /local/file.gguf` Modelfile source, which never
# constructs an hf.co-shaped name at all. recover-oversized-models.sh reads
# this file and does exactly that: download the raw GGUF, import it under
# the short local alias below, and record the mapping here so provenance
# isn't lost once the roster line itself is shortened to the alias.
# The alias tag below is deliberately uppercase (Q4_K_M) because that is what
# Ollama actually writes: `ollama create <name>:q4_k_m` lands on disk as a
# manifest named `Q4_K_M`. The rewrite covers only a subset of
# quantisation-shaped tags -- not tags in general, and NOT only local-file
# imports. Measured on Ollama 0.32.13 by creating throwaway models and
# reading the manifest path back:
#   rewritten to uppercase: q4_0, q8_0, q3_k_m, q4_k_m, q5_k_m
#   left exactly as given:  q4_1, q5_0, q5_1, q2_k, q3_k_s, q3_k_l, q4_k_s,
#                           q5_k_s, q6_k, iq4_xs, f16, latest, and any
#                           non-quantisation tag (e.g. foobar, MiXeD-tag)
# A registry-sourced `FROM` behaved identically to a `FROM /local/file.gguf`
# one (both rewrote `:q4_k_m` -> `:Q4_K_M`), so the source form is not the
# variable. The rule inside Ollama was not determined; what is established is
# that the tag you ask for is not necessarily the tag on disk.
# Ollama *resolves* names case-insensitively (`ollama show <name>:q4_k_m`
# finds the `Q4_K_M` manifest), so this only affects text comparisons against
# `ollama list` output -- those must match case-insensitively.
# Format: local-alias<TAB>upstream-hf-ref<TAB>gguf-filename-in-that-repo
# local-alias         upstream-hf-ref                                                                                                    gguf-filename
ravenx-cyberagent-35b:Q4_K_M
ravenx-chaos-agent-27b:Q4_K_M
